segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin describe the cleanser as helping manage breakouts and leaving skin light and clear, though one who used it with her husband felt it left skin oily and dried out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including dry patches, report it cleans without stripping natural oils and leaves skin soft, moisturized and not tight.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry-leaning skin that turns oily in heat or with makeup says it helps balance both states.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, allergy-prone or 'super extra sensitive' skin most often report no irritation and no breakouts, though two reviewers with sensitive/acne-prone skin report major breakouts after use.
segments.mature: Older reviewers (50s) report compliments on youthful-looking, glowing skin with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 50s report their skin looks younger and gets frequent compliments; no negative reports tied specifically to aging skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out or strip the skin and leaves it soft or moisturized; one reviewer says it dries the skin out and one says it left skin oily and dried at once.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers mention no irritation or flare-ups even on reactive skin; no reports of induced redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers highlight that it cleans 'without stripping' natural oils or moisture, suggesting a gentle, barrier-respecting feel; no dissent noted on this specific point.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report dark marks/discoloration looking brighter and less visible with continued use; one reviewer reports new dark spots appearing after 10 weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including acne-prone and cystic-acne-prone skin, report reduced breakouts, faster resolution of new pimples, or no breakouts at all; however, several reviewers report the opposite — major breakouts, worsening acne, or increased dark spots after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report it manages oil and makeup removal well; one review describes the product feeling oily and drying skin out simultaneously.

extraits.titre: Husband and wife 10 weeks worth of use
extraits.texte: I wanted to love this product because it is black owned. Unfortunately this product did not work well for me nor my husband. The product actually made our skin worse! I didnt have trouble with acne but my husband does. I tried this line with him since my skin was problem free. Well after using this product for 10 weeks I have dark spots and acne. Which i never dealt with. My husband has even more acne than he had before he started. I have went back to anither brand I was using before trying this and slowly my skin is returning to how it was before trying buttah. Buttah isn't non comdogenic which means it has ingredients that could potentially clog your pores and cause problems or worsen your current skin issues.

I have melanated, sensitive and acne prone skin. Because I thought this product would cater to someone with my skin type, I decided to give it a try. WORST MISTAKE I EVER MADE! Using this product twice a day for about 2 weeks caused MAJOR BREAKOUTS

I have tried genuinely about 50 different types of cleansers over the years because my skin hates just about everything. This has been my go to cleanser for the last year! It leaves my skin so soft, refreshed, smooth, and it genuinely leaves it feeling CLEAN. I love using this after taking my makeup off bc it doesn't further irritate my skin and it doesn't dry it out. I have dry skin most of the time but get oily prone in hotter weather or with makeup and I feel like this helps combat that. Cannot suggest this cleanser enough!

Absolutely love this cleanser & I paired it with the AHA/BHA toner. I've been using for about a month after trial and error with Peach & Lily, YTP and Tatcha. This cleared all closed comedones and white heads from my forehead and chin area!

A little of this product goes a long way. This product leaves your face feeling clean and refreshed. I use it twice a day and apply just a bean size amount along with water cleanse my face/ neck. I have very sensitive skin and haven't had any residual affects.

This was my first time trying this cleanser and let me just say it is FANTASTIC! I struggle with dry skin patches near my nose and this has been the only cleanser that works against that! It keeps my skin glowing and moisturized throughout the day! If you're thinking about it, just give it a try!
I am 53 years old and I get so many compliments on my skin. I only use Buttah products. They are great. Also people do not believe I am in my 50's! 😊
